sources.name: Game design
sources.note: Budget and delta-v multipliers, event counts, hint modes and grade thresholds are game balance values.

difficulties.name: Cadet
difficulties.description: Easy. You get a big budget, and hints help you.

difficulties.name: Engineer
difficulties.description: Normal. Real numbers and hard choices. You get hints only when you ask.

difficulties.name: Commander
difficulties.description: Hard. Less money, more delta-v needed and more problems. Good grades are harder to get. No hints.
